column4: cleat#4500: these tests build their shards from real PostgreSQL databases (newRealShards -> bootstrapScratchDB), and sharding is a PostgreSQL configuration -- no sharded MySQL/SQL Server topology exists (same reason as a-workflow-def-is-replicated-to-every-shard.tsv). They skip as bare test names, not a /postgres suffix. Three skips: the per-verb routing test, the no-such-run test and the first-run control. Measured 2026-11-27 with only CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL set: 3 SKIP, ok. They run, and pass, under test-go/engine and cluster, which set the PostgreSQL DSN.
cleat#4500: same three tests, same reason as the multi-db/mysql line above -- multi-db/mssql sets only CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL. Measured 2026-11-27 with only CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL set: 3 SKIP, ok.
